description: Use this whenever the user wants to share, send, show, or publish something you produced: a report, a dashboard, a prototype, a Markdown doc, a PDF, an image. Publishes it to a durable URL that stays live, and returns the link. Pushing the same name again creates a new version at the same link rather than a second link, so prefer reusing a name over inventing one. Pass either `path` (html, md, pdf, png, jpg, gif, webp) or inline `content` with a `filename` (html or md).

content.description: Inline document text (HTML or Markdown) — use with filename

filename.description: Filename for inline content, e.g. report.html or notes.md

password.description: Set a password; anyone who knows it can open the artifact beside team and people access

path.description: Path to the file to push

team.description: Team slug to push to (defaults to the user's default team)

visibility.description: Who can see it: private is only you and people you add, team is everyone in the org, public is anyone with the link

name: push_artifact
